cohort: A preterm neonate born at 31 weeks gestation + 1 day of age by emergency Cesarean Section (CS), with a bloodstream infection (BSI) due to a Verona integron-borne metallo-β-lactamase (VIM)-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae
finding: This case report describes the successful treatment of a bloodstream infection caused by VIM-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae in a preterm neonate using cefiderocol.
mod_finding: The case report describes a preterm neonate, born via emergency cesarean section, who was successfully treated for a bloodstream infection.
